items.q: How did Paul Whiteman become 'King of Blues?' ... Paul Whiteman, Lester Young and others.

ctx.x: Wonderful. Wonderful. We were talking about W. C. Handy the other day. And one of the things that I asked you, you know, you had mentioned that he was a school-teacher. How do you suppose he got to be called the "Father of the Blues?" How does something like that --
Those things happen all during life. (inaudible). How did Paul Whiteman become "King of Blues?" King of --
